title: The Powder Blush Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A fluffy oval brush for easy pickup and diffused application of baked powder formulas without any fallout or mess.

Brush Handle Length: 3.5 Inches

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.

What Else You Need to Know:
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-With a light hand, DIP flat side of Powder Blush Brush into SuperSuede™ Powder Blush (sold separately) or another powder blush.
-Gently TAP off excess pigment from bristles for a controlled, even application.
-Softly SWEEP brush over apples of the cheeks and up toward the temples.
-To keep your brush clean, gently wash it with mild soap and water.

SaieGlow™ Pro Artist Tip:
-For a diffused look and a softer touch, hold the end of the brush handle instead of holding it like a pencil.
-Choose your starting point—where your brush lands first will have the most concentrated pigment.
-Use one side of the Powder Blush Brush's bristles to apply pigment and the opposite clean side to blend.
